summary: SiteDocument is a data structure representing a document attached to a site, containing an ID and a SiteID.
purpose: To model and reference documents associated with specific sites within the system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument instances link documents to sites.
Main purpose is association, no business logic enforced.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page and code-behind that provides a welcome/dashboard interface for administrators and staff users, featuring filtering, document viewing, and validation for employment applications.
purpose: To welcome administrative users, display employment applications, and provide filtering by site, discipline, and date, with strong validation and feedback.

actors.name: Applicant
actors.description: Individual whose employment application is displayed

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering
steps: User selects site and discipline.
User enters start and end dates.
Optional: Show withdrawn applications.
Results grid is refreshed based on filters.

business_rules: Start date and end date are required for filtering.
Date entries must match validation formats; invalid dates are rejected.
conditions: If email is missing, no email icon is shown.
system_behavior: Displays employment applications based on filter criteria.
Shows/hides panels for error/warning messages.
Supports asynchronous refresh and JavaScript-enabled page interactions.
exceptions: Missing fields or improper configuration will cancel selection.

summary: ServiceCode is a data structure and retrieval logic representing service codes, including various fields and localized descriptions.
purpose: To maintain and retrieve lists of service codes for courses and timetables, and support localization.

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll with session.
Return list of service codes, localized as needed.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course/Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
Return filtered list for given entity.

business_rules: If session is in alt language mode, Name and Notes fields are replaced with alt fields.
system_behavior: Retrieves and stores service codes with localization.
Supports filtering by CourseID and TimetableID.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to site profile data, with fields for action details, user, agency, and formatted values.
purpose: To audit site profile changes by users and keep a record with formatted summaries for UI display.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Search
steps: UI triggers search via SiteID and session.
Database procedure returns change history records.

business_rules: If user is not SysAdmin and ByUserID differs from ByOriginalUserID, support team tag is shown.
All changes are formatted for clear UI representation.
calculations: ActionDateFormatted and AgencyUserFormatted are calculated from raw data.
system_behavior: Provides formatted summaries for UI and tooltips.
Tracks change history for audit.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents an email file (attachment or artifact) and a workflow for deleting files and folders after removal.
purpose: To model email-related documents and implement deletion logic, including file and folder cleanup.

workflows.name: Search EmailPopup Documents
steps: Split DataInfo string into records.
Parse each entry into EmailPopupDocument with ID, FileName, FilePath.
Return list.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopup Document
steps: Delete file at FilePath.
Delete its folder if possible.
Return remaining dataInfo string.

business_rules: On deletion, both file and containing folder should be removed if possible.
conditions: Only entries with DataInfo and FilePath are processed.
system_behavior: Deletes files and folders as part of cleanup.
Search returns structured records from DataInfo string.
exceptions: File deletion or directory deletion failures are caught and ignored.

summary: ExpenseBatch models a batch of department expense records, with fields for batch details, date, status, and formatting. Includes workflow for CRUD operations and status management.
purpose: To manage expense batch records for departments, allowing add, update, search, delete, and retrieving batch information.

workflows.name: ExpenseBatch CRUD
steps: Add batch: provide departmentID, description, date.
Search batches: filter by departmentID.
Update batch info and status as needed.
Delete batches by ID.

workflows.name: Format Batch Number
steps: Format batch number as 'ID - StatusDescription' for display.

business_rules: StatusDescription uses alt-language if session requires.
Add, update, search, and delete are permission scoped via session.
system_behavior: CRUD operations for batch records.
Can search batches for department within last year.

summary: CostCentre is a set of record types and retrieval logic summarizing placement cost centre information for reporting, including agencies, departments, disciplines, sites, dates, counts, and hours.
purpose: To retrieve cost centre data for placements, enabling reporting and filtering on many attributes.

workflows.name: GetCostCentre
steps: Call GetCostCentre with sessionID, date range, and optional filters.
Returns list of CostCentreRecords, each summarizing placement financial and operational data.

system_behavior: Retrieves placement cost centre data for reporting.
Supports filtering and aggregates on attributes.

summary: TimetableAssessments is an ASP.NET web page and supporting code for managing student assessments tied to timetables, including add/edit/delete, validation, and detailed workflows for assessment definitions.
purpose: To provide staff a UI to add, edit, delete, and validate student assessment entries tied to timetables, with business logic for assessment types, templates, view permissions, and optional sections.

workflows.name: Student Assessment Management
steps: Page loads and binds assessment grid.
Add/Edit/Delete handled via FormView and GridView.
Assessment templates and types are validated and selected.
View permissions and optional section logic are managed via UI JS and backend.
Validation errors are displayed for interim/final, instructor/supervisor, and maximum exceeded cases.

business_rules: Interim assessments must have a final assessment.
Instructors and supervisors cannot be assessed together.
Permissions for assessor and subject viewing answers are configurable.
validations: Required fields for assessor, subject, assessment type, template.
Open and close days must be integers.
Days after placement dates must be logical.
system_behavior: Displays grid and popups for assessment editing.
Enforces validations and business rules prior to saving.
Uses AJAX and JS for dynamic UI changes.
exceptions: JavaScript handles confirm dialogs and UI exceptions.

summary: AdHocQuery provides reusable methods to render SQL query results as HTML tables for display and reporting.
purpose: To create dynamic, structured HTML tables from SQL data for ad hoc reporting.

workflows.name: SQL Data to HTML Table
steps: Call DataReaderToHTMLTable with a SQLDataReader.
HeaderRow, DataRow, and FooterRow are generated in sequence.
Result is a formatted HTML table.

system_behavior: Generates HTML using table, header, rows, and cell formatting.
Handles null values and formats accordingly.

summary: StudentPrerequisites is a data structure and workflow for storing, updating, and validating student prerequisite information including immunization, health, mask fit, confidentiality, and associated logic.
purpose: To track, validate, and update all prerequisite health, safety, and confidentiality data for a student, supporting complex business rules and validations.

workflows.name: Student Prerequisite Data Management
steps: Search for prerequisites via StudentID/StaffID.
Validate and update data for health, mask fit, confidentiality, immunization.
Enforce business rules (dates, required fields, value ranges).
If no record found, create empty default.
Update various aspects by specialized methods.

business_rules: Dates must not be more than 5 years in the past or future.
Years for confirmed events must be between MIN_YEAR and MaxYear.
Expiry dates must be logical (e.g., after completed dates).
Required fields must be present or error is returned.
French and English alt fields are handled separately in logic.
validations: All health, mask, immunization, and confidentiality fields are validated against date/business rules.
Special rules for fit test dates, expiry years, medical completed, immunization fee dates.
calculations: Formatted fields for UI display, e.g., ImmunReqMetDateFormatted.
conditions: If user is sysadmin, validation may differ.
Empty record returned if search yields no data.
system_behavior: Stores, updates, and validates all student prerequisite information.
Provides formatted fields for UI consumption.
Handles both English and French field variants.
exceptions: If validation fails, error message added and update aborted.
